findings.label: Mechanism B ranks first on four of five criteria and loses only on load reliability which is one line
Mechanism D ranks second and should carry exactly one check
Mechanism C ranks third and suits a nudge not the check
Mechanism E ranks fourth and is mis-specified because command recommendation does not exist
Mechanism A ranks last on change cost and enforcement at once
The missing chat-path check is the workflow's unconditional document_all_decisions rule
The card declares a fill note to be the section contract so an existing note is the cheapest carrier
The smallest change set is three one-line edits to existing files and no new artifact
What not to build is every mechanism the ranking eliminated plus any blocking Level 1 gate
The recommendation lowers frequency but cannot prove a fresh-context read

ruledOutDetailed.direction: Recommending mechanism D as the primary carrier
ruledOutDetailed.reason: It cannot read judgment, and the check that matters most here is a judgment.

ruledOutDetailed.direction: Recommending a co-equal B and C combination
ruledOutDetailed.reason: Two carriers for one check double maintenance and attention for no additional enforcement.

ruledOutDetailed.direction: Recommending the optional fourth change by default
ruledOutDetailed.reason: It belongs to the operator's choice of visibility, not to the minimum.
